'''Synthflesh''', also '''syntheflesh'''<ref name="CSWE" /> or '''plaskin''',<ref name="Starcave of ThonBoka">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Starcave of ThonBoka]]''</ref> was a medical product widely used throughout the galaxy.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:TDLsynthflesh-FF94.png|thumb|left|250px|The arms and torso of the [[TDL nanny droid]] was covered in synthflesh.]]
A translucent gel derived from [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]], synthflesh acted as a cellular regeneration medium; when applied to superficial wounds, synthflesh sealed the skin and promoted rapid healing of the damaged tissue. After the gel dried, it would slowly flake off to reveal new and scarless tissue. Due to its impressive medical applications, it was common to find syntheflesh in first-aid kits and [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]].<ref name="CSWE" />

Synthflesh also referred to a highly advanced form of material related to [[Synthskin/Legends|synthskin]]; this form of synthflesh was grown, and was used to cover artificial limbs to make them look real (such as the hyper-realistic [[Repli-Limb Prosthetic Replacements]]), or in the case of [[Synthdroid]]s, the entirety of the droid. Extremely realistic, synthflesh looked and felt like organic skin and muscle,<ref name="CSWE" /> and was capable of matching the recipient's flesh tone and muscle build by using the recipient's genetic code as a template.<ref name="CRFG" />
